name: Mercedes-Benz of Laguna Niguel
climate: Mild Southern California coastal/inland climate; no snow or road salt.
brandNaming: Write "Mercedes-Benz" in full in copy and headings; do not shorten it to "Mercedes" or "Benz"
Say service "offers" or "Service Offers", never "coupon" or "coupons" (brand terms ledger MB-001)
Say "Genuine Mercedes-Benz parts": they are recommended, never required, and never say other parts "void" a warranty
When describing MBUX or driver-assistance features, add the Mercedes-Benz "Digital Extras" availability disclaimer
Scheduled maintenance is "Service A" and "Service B"; timing comes from the Maintenance Booklet and the vehicle's ASSYST PLUS service indicator
Sprinter and eSprinter vans are sold and serviced by the sister store on the same 1 Star Dr campus (lagunasprintervans.com); keep this store's articles on passenger vehicles

exceptions.rule: !important on article link and button colors (color plus -webkit-text-fill-color) and on #di-page-composer-prefixed heading sizes
exceptions.source: The DealerInspire theme sets global link colors (a, a:visited, a:active) and Page Composer heading sizes; the proven DI embeds need !important to keep the article's own link and button colors and type scale
